verdict.rationale: Docs show explicit guardrail examples like transferring an enterprise ticket 'to the enterprise team with a summary note' (docs-7) and gating actions with Slack approvals that include the triggering context (docs-31, docs-6), and the agent operates inside ticketing systems (Intercom, Zendesk, etc.) where the full conversation thread naturally persists (docs-15). However, there's no explicit documentation of a structured 'full conversation + summary + collected details' handoff package or confirmation that customers never have to repeat themselves across channels. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a structured escalation payload combining full transcript, auto-generated summary, and collected form/details, plus independent/hands-on confirmation that context is fully preserved on human takeover.
